limitations: No CAN manual for firmware V1.0.7 or V1.0.8 exists in the repository; their changes are known only from the version notes.
Two different documents are both labelled manual V1.0.9 for firmware V1.0.9 (MK109A Dec-2025, MK109 Nov-2026); the firmware label alone does not identify the command set.
No firmware image, PC tool, installer or example code was executed; no archive was extracted to disk.
No hardware contacted and no vendor correspondence; nothing here is a hardware observation.
The official product listings are JavaScript shells; no manufacturer page fixes board revision or shipped firmware.
SERVO28D_CAN and SERVO35D_CAN have no dedicated CAN manual; the 28D_CAN schematic was not stored.
Public accessibility in a license-less repository does not establish redistribution permission.
